meta.title: Octetlab — a network lab in your browser
meta.description: A free, open-source network lab in your browser. Build and cable networks, configure them from a GUI or an IOS-style CLI, watch every packet in simulation mode, and learn with sample labs, troubleshooting exercises and design tasks.
